title: Stop exposing raw MCP session IDs
description: The agent ID is the MCP session ID, which works like a bearer credential: anyone who sends it as `Mcp-Session-Id` acts as that agent. It's shown to other agents (Claim.agent_id, "claimed by agent …" errors, the task context) and written into committed history. Use a derived ID (e.g. a short hash, or a per-session random name) for display and storage, keeping the session ID only in memory.
